description: Move group restaurant ate_already and food moodlet records from unhandled prise_date callback into executed event 853 body. Keep legacy callback and all other effects unchanged.

edits.old:
IF interaction = 853:
 $interaction_type = 'prise_date'
 slave['teambuilding_3'] = 1
 assistant['teambuilding_3'] = 1
praise_potence = 5
 slave['promise_reward'] = 0
 praise_potence = 4 + (slave["moral"]*2 + slave["rational"] + slave["instinct"] + slave["spoil"] - slave["fear"])*4 - already_done_curslave[interaction]
 if slave["passion_fame"] = -1:  praise_potence = praise_potence/2
 if slave["passion_sweets"] < 0: praise_potence -= 4
if praise_potence <= 0: praise_potence = 1
 if slave["passion_sweets"] > 0: praise_potence += praise_potence
 date_success = 5
 if praise_potence < 40: date_success = 4
 if praise_potence < 10: date_success = 3
 if praise_potence < 5: date_success = 2
 if praise_potence <= 1: date_success = 1
 IF date_success > 2:
  slave['promise_reward'] = 0
  if slave["sin"] = 0 and slave["pride"] < 4: slave_rate["temper"] += 1 & slave_rate["moral"] += 2
 END
prise_cost = 12
 add_master_hygiene = 3
 add_slave_hygiene = 3
 add_house_mess = 1
 slave["<<assistant['id']>>"] += date_success
 assistant["<<slave['id']>>"] += date_success
 $text[1] = '<<$date_treesome_description[1]>>'
 $text[2] = '  <<$date_treesome_result[date_success]>>'
 $place = 'restaurant'
 daily_reward_count += 1
 special_food = 1
 assistant["special_food"] = 1
 if slave["passion_fame"] ! 0 and slave["passion_fame_revealed"] = 0: slave["passion_fame_revealed"] = 1
 if slave["passion_sweets"] ! 0 and slave["passion_sweets_revealed"] = 0: slave["passion_sweets_revealed"] = 1
 $special_part = {
    if date_success > assistant['pos_slave_date']: assistant['pos_slave_date'] = date_success
    if master_moodlet['pos_self_food'] < 1: master_moodlet['pos_self_food'] = 1
    ate_already = 5 &! JO9 RM fix: completed restaurant meal counts as dinner.
    dynamic $assistant_energy_drop
    assistant["rewarded_today"] += praise_potence*3
 }
END

!Beach Trip for Three - mrross
